title: Finite etale stage carrying a prescribed simple root
statement: theorem etaleResidueTriples_simple_root_stage (R : CommRingCat.{u}) (p : Spec R) (K : Type u) [Field K] [Algebra ((Spec R).residueField p) K] [IsSepClosure ((Spec R).residueField p) K] (c : Cocone (etaleResidueTriplesRingDiagram R p K (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap ((Spec R).residueField p) K)))) (hc : IsColimit c) (ψ : c.pt →+* K) (hψ : ∀ t, ψ.comp (c.ι.app t).hom = ((ΓSpecIso t.B).inv ≫ (Spec t.B).Γevaluation t.q ≫ t.φ).hom) : ∀ f : Polynomial c.pt, f.Monic → ∀ a₀ : K, f.eval₂ ψ a₀ = 0 → f.derivative.eval₂ ψ a₀ ≠ 0 → ∃ t : EtaleResidueTriples R p K (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap ((Spec R).residueField p) K)), ∃ x : t.B, f.IsRoot (c.ι.app t x) ∧ ψ (c.ι.app t x) = a₀

proof.text: Obtain filteredness from etaleResidueTriples_filtered_colimit. Prove joint surjectivity directly: the union of the cocone-leg images is a subring, since any two representatives have a common successor. Restrict the cocone to this subring. By the colimit universal property its inclusion admits a right inverse, hence every colimit element is in a stage image. Lift the finite set of coefficients to a common successor, and apply Polynomial.lifts_and_natDegree_eq_and_monic to obtain a monic polynomial g over that stage whose image is f. All these descent steps are proved in the private helpers stage_range_subset, stage_jointly_surjective, and stage_monic_polynomial, without a smallness assumption on the indexing category.

Use hψ, Polynomial.eval₂_map, and Polynomial.derivative_map to transfer the prescribed simple-root conditions to g evaluated under the stage map to K. Form the StandardEtalePair with f=g and second polynomial g.derivative; the Bezout certificate is (1,0,1). Its universal algebra is etale over the stage, and StandardEtalePair.lift gives evaluation γ at a₀. Let q be ker γ. Lift γ to the ideal residue field and compose with Spec.residueFieldIso to obtain the scheme residue embedding. Spec.algebraMap_residueFieldIso_inv and Ideal.ResidueField.lift_algebraMap show that its composite with the canonical ring-to-residue map is γ. The old ring-to-K map has kernel the old prime because both residue-field maps are injective, so q lies over that prime. Composition of etale morphisms, the old compatibility equation, and γ.commutes produce a new triple and a morphism from the old triple. These calculations are proved in triple_map_eq_zero and triple_simple_root_extension.

Take the universal element P.X in the new triple. StandardEtalePair.hasMap_X proves its polynomial equation and StandardEtalePair.lift_X gives its image a₀. Cocone naturality identifies the two images of g in c.pt. Polynomial.map_map, Polynomial.eval_map and Polynomial.eval₂_at_apply transport the root equation to f. Finally hψ transfers its value in K to ψ applied to the cocone image.

proof_origin: Stacks Project algebra.tex, lemma-henselization (Tag 04GN), final proof paragraph, and lemma-strict-henselization (Tag 04GP); full finite-stage construction formalized by M1. Coefficient descent is proved directly from filteredness and the colimit universal property; standard etale and residue-field calculations use the existing Mathlib leaves.
